title: The Gift of the Magi
prompt: A faithful full-text adaptation: the user supplies the COMPLETE public-domain text of O. Henry's 'The Gift of the Magi' (2,057 words) and asks for an illustrated audiobook film — a gentle English narrator reads the original sentence by sentence with nothing dropped or rewritten (duration follows the text, ~18 min), over warm early-1900s picture-book illustrations with English subtitles. Della's identity is held by per-state anchors: one long-haired anchor before the haircut, one short-curls anchor after — every page attaches the anchor matching its point in the story.

nodes.label: creative brief
nodes.caption: Structured metadata document (JSON) for a user-submitted text brief. Payload carries the raw text verbatim. Pipeline entry point — consumed by story / screenplay / narration agents.
nodes.excerpt:
{"text": "我会上传欧·亨利《麦琪的礼物》的原文全文(公版英文)。帮我改编成一条带旁白的短片,严格忠于原著——情节、人物、结尾那个反转一字不动,不要现代化改写也不要加戏删减。视觉做成 20 世纪初纽约小公寓的暖旧质感、彩色绘本插画风,基调温暖带一丝心酸。时长跟着原文篇幅走。旁白用英文按原文逐句朗读(温柔男声),配英文字幕。保留公寓的环境音——壁炉、街声、钟摆,配乐压低烘托,不要盖过旁白。
